question: On Monday morning a garden centre took in 7 trays of bedding plants, with 207 plants in every tray. During the week 1407 of the plants were sold. On Friday morning the grower Anna potted up 56 more plants, and her colleague Tomas brought 71 from his own greenhouse, although Tomas had raised fewer plants overall than Anna. On Friday afternoon a landscaping firm bought 134 plants. How many plants were left at the garden centre that evening?

On Monday morning a stationery depot stacked 8 pallets, each holding 191 boxes of envelopes. Later that morning 56 loose boxes were added from a returned order. In the afternoon the depot manager Ruth had every box in the building broken open into 6 bundles of envelopes. Her assistant Nils handled fewer bundles that day than Ruth did. In the evening all the bundles were split equally between 3 delivery lorries, and the lorry heading for Ashwell took one of those equal loads. How many bundles were on the Ashwell lorry?

A school received 12 tins of paint, and every tin was decanted into 3 glass jars. The jars were shared equally between 2 art rooms, and the upstairs room took one of those shares. A mural that covers 9 square metres used up 12 jars from the upstairs room. The jars still left there were divided equally among the 3 classes that use the room, and Class B took one share. Class B split its jars equally between 2 project groups, and the model-making group received one of the parts. The model-making group's cupboard already held 68 jars of paint. How many jars did the model-making group then have?

Nadia had 151 empty photo frames in her studio and sold 55 of them at a market. Every frame she kept holds 6 photographs. Her colleague Peter frames photographs too, but he mounted fewer of them this year than Nadia did. The studio is 20 metres from the bus stop. Nadia later tripled the number of photographs she had mounted by working through an old archive. A gallery then bought 1531 of the photographs from her. How many photographs did Nadia still have?

A recycling depot began the month with 222 crates of glass, and 106 crates went to the furnace straight away. Every crate that stayed was emptied into 3 smaller bins. The depot yard is 45 metres wide. A collection lorry took 278 of the bins away. The number of bins still at the depot was then tripled by a delivery of identical bins from a partner site, and a neighbour dropped off 50 more. How many bins were at the depot then?

A camping shop had 182 tent pegs in its stockroom. It sold 58 pegs on Friday and lost 33 more in a flooded box. A supplier sent 26 pegs, and a returned order added 20 others. A dozen of the pegs are the heavy steel kind used for winter camping. The shop van can carry 900 pegs at once. Every peg was then packed with 5 guy ropes to make a set, and 67 spare ropes found in a drawer were counted with them. How many guy ropes were counted?

Kwame packs 139 tea bags into every carton at the factory. Each shipping box holds 6 cartons, and each pallet takes 3 shipping boxes. The factory canteen seats 75 people. Kwame's colleague Beatrice packed fewer tea bags than he did on the same shift. A quality check put 46 loose tea bags back onto the pallet, and a split carton added another 28. How many tea bags were on the pallet?

Early on Sunday a bike hire kiosk had 143 helmets on its racks. Groups hired 135 helmets before lunch. In the early afternoon 17 helmets came back, and later a delivery brought 39 new ones. A dozen of the helmets are the small children's size. The kiosk stands 6 kilometres from the town centre. That evening the manager fitted every helmet in the kiosk with 9 replacement pads. How many replacement pads did the manager fit?

A wildlife group counted 224 nesting boxes across a woodland that covers 60 hectares. Half of the boxes stand on the north side, and the group surveyed that half only. Surveyors found 102 of the boxes they checked to be empty. Every box that was occupied held 4 chicks. Predators took 36 of those chicks over the following week. Each chick that survived was fitted with 3 coloured rings. How many coloured rings were used?

A community centre had 231 chairs at the start of the season. 22 chairs were scrapped as broken, and a hall closure sent 54 more chairs to the centre. A dozen of the chairs are the padded sort kept for the committee room. Every chair takes 5 minutes to set out, and the caretaker added up the setup minutes for all of them. He records this work in minutes even though his timesheet is filled in with hours. He saved 777 minutes by using a trolley, and his colleague Ana added 15 minutes of her own, although Ana worked fewer minutes overall than he did. How many minutes did the setup finally come to?

A garden club had 149 packets of seeds in its cupboard. Damp ruined 26 of the packets. A member donated 55 packets, and a seed swap brought in 16 more. A dozen of the packets hold sunflower seeds. The club meets in a hall that is 30 metres long. A late parcel then added 9 further packets. How many packets of seeds were in the cupboard?

A workshop had 171 sheets of plywood in stock and bought 23 more. Every sheet is cut into 4 panels, and each panel is sanded on 2 faces, with one sanding job counted for each face. Every sanding job uses 8 units of abrasive paper. The workshop times its jobs in minutes although the customer quotes are written in hours. The foreman Louis logged more sanding jobs than his apprentice Nina did, and the store room holds 300 sheets when full. How many units of abrasive paper does the whole run need?

On Monday morning a bakery filled 9 racks with 133 bread rolls each. Before noon 298 rolls were sold at the counter. In the afternoon a cancelled order put 33 rolls back on the racks. The bakery oven holds 60 rolls at a time. The baker records proving times in minutes even though the shift plan is written in hours. That evening the same day's figures were matched at each of 7 branches, and the chain then ran 8 identical days. How many rolls did the chain handle altogether?

On Saturday morning a market trader loaded 4 vans, each carrying 144 punnets of berries. At midday a grower added 11 punnets that had been left behind. During the afternoon a neighbouring stall passed over 71 punnets it could not sell. In the evening a cafe handed back 22 punnets. How many punnets did the trader have at the end of the day?

On Monday morning a school library had 155 books waiting to be shelved. Later that morning a donation added 40 books to the pile. In the afternoon a class returned 25 more. In the evening the pile was shared equally between the 5 librarians on duty, and Farid took one of those equal shares. Farid then had to process his share 2 times over, once for the catalogue and once for the labels, counting one job for each book on each pass. How many processing jobs did Farid have?

A stationery mill produced 76 reams of paper on its first shift, and the second shift produced exactly as much again, so the day's output came to double the first shift's. Each ream is split into 7 packs. Every pack holds 8 notebooks. The mill chimney is 30 metres tall. A wholesaler bought 6254 notebooks from that day's output, and 508 more were pulped after a water leak. How many notebooks from that day were left?

A cycling club had 148 water bottles in its store, and a sponsor sent 68 more. The whole stock was then split into 2 equal shares, one for the road team and one for the track team. The road team's coach Bella collected her team's share. A shop later donated 32 bottles to the road team, and the track coach Marc passed over 31 that his own team no longer needed, which left Marc with fewer bottles than Bella. The club records its ride times in minutes even though the newsletter prints them in hours. How many bottles did the road team have?

A school music room started the term with 171 reeds for its clarinets. 93 reeds were handed out to beginners, and 75 more split and were thrown away. Each reed still in the box was packaged with 6 spare ligatures for a fundraising sale. The music room has 24 music stands. 11 of the ligatures were lost in transit, and a supplier then sent 69 more. The teacher logs practice in minutes even though the reports to parents are given in hours. How many ligatures did the music room have?

A hostel kitchen began the week with 93 jars of jam. 5 jars were broken when a shelf gave way. A donation added 59 jars. Guests ate their way through 55 jars, and a school trip took another 73 away. A dozen of the jars are the marmalade kind kept for staff, and the kitchen has 8 fridges along the back wall. 4 more jars went mouldy, and a supplier then delivered 56 fresh ones. How many jars of jam did the kitchen have?

A youth theatre had 14 costumes in store and borrowed 78 more from a neighbouring group, a dozen of them Victorian. Each costume needs 5 minutes of pressing before a show. The pressing work was shared equally among the 4 wardrobe helpers, and Dita took one of those shares of the minutes. She then spent 19 more minutes repairing a hem. The company writes these totals in minutes even though the production budget is set out in hours. Dita repeated exactly that amount of work before each of the 4 performances, and she spent a further 62 minutes on repairs on the closing night. How many minutes of work did Dita do in all?

A hardware shop had 114 tins of varnish and sold 77 of them in a spring sale. A wholesaler then delivered 56 more tins. A dozen of the tins are the clear matt finish. Every tin covers 9 square metres of decking. One customer's decking measures 200 square metres. An opened tin added 6 square metres of coverage to the shop's total, and a returned tin added 47 more. How many square metres of decking could the shop's stock cover?

A driving school had 163 lesson slots booked for the month. 86 slots were used in the first week and 27 in the second. Bad weather forced 47 slots to be cancelled altogether. A new instructor then added 59 slots to the diary. Every slot still in the diary needs 8 pages of paperwork. The office records lesson lengths in minutes even though the invoices to learners quote hours. How many pages of paperwork does the diary require?

A cafe had 177 loyalty cards in circulation and issued 68 more in one week. 55 cards were filled up and handed back, and 3 were reported lost. Every card still in circulation carries 4 unused stamp spaces, and the manager Odette counted those spaces. Her colleague Ravi counted fewer spaces on his own set of cards than Odette did. Odette then crossed out 29 spaces that had expired. The cafe records its opening times in minutes even though the door sign gives them in hours. How many stamp spaces did Odette's count come to?

Hugo bakes 27 shortbread rounds on each of the 5 trays he owns. A neighbour gave him 80 more rounds for the village sale. His sister Mia contributed 45, although Mia had baked fewer rounds than Hugo. The village hall has 96 chairs. Hugo then repeated his whole collection 5 times over, so that every stall at the fair could have the same amount. How many shortbread rounds did Hugo end up with?

A repair shop had 132 bicycle inner tubes on the rack. 118 tubes went out with a bulk order, and 10 more were found perished. A delivery brought 28 tubes back into stock, and 9 were used on same-day repairs. A dozen of the tubes are the wide sort for mountain bikes. Each tube still on the rack is bagged with 8 patches for sale. The shop times its repairs in minutes although the quotes to customers are given in hours. How many patches does the shop need for that bagging?
